issue_context.title: `ERR_LOAD_PUBLIC_URL` happens when `<script src="/file-in-public.js">` exists
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

If the `index.html` includes `<script src="/file-in-public.js"></script>`, Vite outputs the following error.

```
Error: Failed to load url /config.js (resolved id: /config.js). This file is in /public and will be 
copied as-is during build without going through the plugin transforms, and therefore should not be imported from source code. It can only be referenced via HTML tags.
    at loadAndTransform (file:///C:/Users/green/Downloads/vitejs-vite-pruyw5/node_modules/vite/dist/node/chunks/dep-f997966e.js:40835:21) {
  code: 'ERR_LOAD_PUBLIC_URL'
}
```
The error is output after accessing the page.

**This happens in main branch ([8da04227d6f818a8ad9efc0056101968037c2e36](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/8da04227d6f818a8ad9efc0056101968037c2e36))** and not with 4.3.0-beta.0.

I guess #12599 is affecting this one. /cc @bluwy 



### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-pruyw5?file=main.js&terminal=dev

review_comments:
I actually don't know what the `html` option here is for. I've seen it used at

https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/8da04227d6f818a8ad9efc0056101968037c2e36/packages/vite/src/node/server/middlewares/transform.ts#L186

only. And that lines implies that the `url` is an `html` file? I've ran a couple apps to see when this gets triggered, but it always seems that the value is false.

> And that lines implies that the url is an html file? 

It looks so.

Maybe we can add an new option called `public`. When `public` is true,  bypass the public file load process directly?
I think we shouldn't call preTransformRequest on public files.

I think we should check in `indexHtml` middleware if the file is a public file before calling `transformRequest` on it. That might the simplest approach. It would be good to avoid another option as it creates a separate cacheKey in `transformRequest` and makes caching a bit less useful.

It also looks like the `html` option is used here:

https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/871d3533f7b29cbe4f7f8bd188362e0c9bc75d41/packages/vite/src/node/server/transformRequest.ts#L177-L181

I think this was used long long time ago where HTML is processed by `transformRequest` too, which now doesn't.

I'll open another PR with the checking approach.
Ah I didn't saw the comments before I made mine. GitHub 🙃. I've already created https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/12650
